title: so damn optimized
description: Just an optimization modpack I made for my potato PC and for yours too.
body:
# 🧩 so damn optimized
### ⚙️ About This Modpack

This modpack is made for low-end and potato PCs — just like mine!
I built it using my Intel m3-8100Y laptop with UHD 615 graphics, which isn’t exactly powerful.
Despite that, this modpack delivers smooth and stable performance that makes the game much more playable on weak hardware.

## 🚀 Performance Boost

Before making this modpack, I only got:
- 🎮 25 to 50 FPS

Now, I’m getting:
- ⚡ 60 to 200+ FPS, depending on the world and settings

It’s optimized for:

- ✅ Smoother performance
- ⚡ Faster loading
- 🧱 Better stability

Perfect for players who just want to enjoy the game without lag or frame drops.

## ⚠️ Important Note


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

⚠️ Warning: When installing extra mods, there’s a high chance of crashing.
This modpack is based on VulkanMod, not Sodium, which means it can be sensitive to mod compatibility issues.

💡 Tip: Add new mods one at a time and test after each install.

</details>



## 💡 Summary

- 🪶 Lightweight and optimized for low-end PCs
- 🧠 Built around VulkanMod (not Sodium)
- 💻 Tested on Intel m3-8100Y (UHD 615 iGPU)
- 🚫 May crash with certain third-party mods
- ✅ Designed for stable, lag-free gameplay
